name: Sit-up
notes: Bodyweight sit-up performed on the floor.

guide.setup: Lie on your back with the knees bent and the feet flat, heels a short way from the hips, and the hands crossed on the chest or resting lightly by the temples.
guide.execution: Curl the spine off the floor one segment at a time until the torso is upright over the hips, then reverse the movement and lower under control until the shoulder blades touch down.
guide.cues: Lead with the ribs, not the chin. Keep a fist of space under the jaw. Exhale on the way up and take as long to lower as to rise.
guide.mistakes: Pulling on the head with the hands; anchoring the feet and hauling with the hip flexors; bouncing off the floor between reps; cutting the descent short.
